page.overview:
Who is Florian Reiss?

Florian was a small 10-year old girl with long black hair and light eyes. She was only ever seen wearing a plain white robe with a long white v-neck dress and a black waistband with white sandals.

In the year 845, when Wall Maria was breached, Grisha Yeager invaded the Reiss Chapel, turned into a Titan, and killed most of Reiss family members including Florian Reiss herself. According to Rod Reiss, she was "stomped" together with her mother in Grisha's feet. Before Grisha attacked, she fearfully clung to her mother.
